text:
maria (AE): Heads up — SovereignBank signed NDA and wants a 2‑week private POC. Key asks in the RFP: customer-managed KMS for model keys, preserve client source IP for downstream logging, no outbound internet from the private deployment, and answers to a security questionnaire by EOD Wednesday. Also wants rough pricing for Dedicated capacity w/ >=100 rps.

devin (Solutions Eng): Cool. From a connectivity standpoint we need to pick PrivateLink vs VPC Peering. PrivateLink gives better isolation but needs interface endpoints per AZ and outbound egress still via our NAT/proxy unless they use a proxy in their VPC. Peering is simpler for internal-only traffic but exposes their VPC route table to ours.

alex (NetOps): For no outbound internet requirement we can put the private nodes in a private subnet and force egress through an on‑prem proxy over a tunnel, or terminate outbound at their NAT GW with strict SGs. If they insist on zero egress, we can restrict SGs to only the PrivateLink interface endpoint and our own management CIDRs.

natalie (Security): KMS integration: we support customer KMS for model encryption at rest via envelope encryption (callout: we don't currently support HSM signing inside the runtime). We'll need their KMS ARNs and an IAM role that allows Encrypt/Decrypt for the key. Can they commit to cross-account IAM role setup? Also need to confirm whether key usage must be restricted to specific regions.

ken (Infra Eng): Implementation notes: 1) For BYO KMS we require a short maintenance window to rotate mounts. 2) If they want client src IP preserved all the way to their logging sink we need to avoid SNAT in the egress path — that usually means a transit VPC with hairpin NAT disabled or PrivateLink with proxy that preserves x-forwarded-for and TCP source IP via a tunnel. 3) mTLS between their ingress and our connector is supported; we'll provide cert templates.

maria (AE): They also flagged latency SLAs — "p95 < 250ms" for simple completions. Any ballpark on whether Dedicated 4xA10G could meet that from us to their EU region? Pricing too?

ken (Infra Eng): Ballpark: if they're < 2k tokens per request and <100 rps, Dedicated 4xA10G in eu-west should comfortably hit p95 ~120‑200ms for short sequences depending on model and quantization. I'll attach a perf note separately. Pricing: monthly reserved + overage. For a short POC we can quote a 1‑month reserved at ~ $Xk + usage tier; will follow up with exact numbers.

devin (Solutions Eng): Regarding the security questionnaire: Natalie — can you give a short set of standard answers we can paste? They asked about data residency, key management, and access controls.

natalie (Security): Quick snippets: 1) Data residency — customer data stored in their selected cloud region for Private deployments; backups optional. 2) KMS — BYO KMS supported via cross-account role and envelope encryption; provide ARN + role. 3) Access control — RBAC via SSO, audit logs forwarded to customer SIEM via syslog/forwarder. 4) Pen test — we accept attestation and scheduled coop tests; on‑prem installs require a scoping call. Use these, I'll iterate if they push.

alex (NetOps): Firewall rules checklist for customer: allow outbound TLS to our management CIDRs (we'll provide exact IPs), allow the interface endpoint security group inbound from their app subnets, and allow IPsec BGP if they opt for a tunnel. Ports: 443 for API, 22 only if they request bastion access (discouraged), 123/ntp optional. We'll send a compact snippet they can paste into their firewall change.

maria (AE): Customer follow-up: they want a one‑pager network checklist + exact port/IP list, KMS setup steps, and a 30‑min call with NetOps/Infra tomorrow morning. Can we have the one‑pager and pricing by EOD today so I can attach to the reply?

ken (Infra Eng): I'll draft the one‑pager (network checklist + perf caveats + recommended PrivateLink topology) and include a templated IAM trust policy and cert example. Expect draft in ~3 hours.

devin (Solutions Eng): I'll compile the pricing cushion for a 2‑week POC + 1‑month dedicated eval and include an optional canary rollback/capacity plan for burst handling.

natalie (Security): I'll scrub the questionnaire answers and add any compliance caveats (SOC2/ISO references) and signal which items need legal signoff.

maria (AE): Awesome — I'll schedule the call for 09:30 CET tomorrow and loop in SovereignBank netsec. tagging @devin @alex @ken @natalie :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: POC-dedicated-cluster PR #1023 queued for staging (eta 02:15).

alex (NetOps): Note for the record — if they want SNAT-free egress we must validate their load balancer capabilities; some managed LB vendors do SNAT by default and it's a blocker. I'll include a checklist question for vendor and LB type.

maria (AE): Thanks all — will post the customer's security questionnaire and KMS ARNs in this thread when received.
